[Unit]
Description=Mark the Current Boot Loader Entry as Good
Documentation=man:systemd-bless-boot.service(8)
DefaultDependencies=no
Requires=boot-complete.target
After=local-fs.target boot-complete.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target
Before=shutdown.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-bless-boot good

# /usr/lib/systemd/system/systemd-bless-boot.service.d/astraeus.conf
[Unit]
Requires=astraeus-confirm-boot.service
After=astraeus-confirm-boot.service

[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/bin/distroctl confirm-boot
# /usr/lib/systemd/system/astraeus-confirm-boot.service
[Unit]
Description=Confirm the pending Astraeus boot using observed health
After=local-fs.target NetworkManager.service sddm.service systemd-logind.service
ConditionPathExists=!/run/archiso
ConditionPathExists=|/var/log/astraeus/transactions.sqlite
ConditionPathExists=|/var/log/astraeus/private/transactions.sqlite

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/distroctl confirm-boot
TimeoutStartSec=180

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical.target
